sourceFindings.preconditions: S1 isolated browser; settled dashboard; root initially dark
steps: Inspect persisted theme and document root
sourceFindings.expected: Selecting light theme removes the dark class and visibly renders the light theme.
sourceFindings.actual: The persisted theme changes to light, but document.documentElement retains the dark class and the UI remains dark.

sourceFindings.control: Create API Key / shared Modal and confirmation surfaces
sourceFindings.preconditions: S1 isolated browser; desktop; seeded keys
steps: Inspect active element and dialog semantics
Repeat on one-time key, delete, shutdown, changelog and request-details drawer
sourceFindings.expected: A modal has dialog semantics, moves focus inside, traps focus, closes on Escape where applicable, and returns focus to its opener.
sourceFindings.actual: The overlays have no role=dialog, leave focus on the opener/background, expose background links, and return focus to document body instead of the opener; Language and Change Log also ignore Escape.

sourceFindings.preconditions: Today data loaded; synthetic GET /api/usage/stats?period=24h returns marked 500
steps: Intercept 24h stats with X-QA-Synthetic-State: 1 and status 500
sourceFindings.expected: The failed period is not presented as current data; show an error/retry or explicit stale state.
sourceFindings.actual: 24h becomes visually selected, the prior Today value (23) remains unchanged, and no error, retry, or stale indicator appears.

sourceFindings.expected: Show a distinguishable error with a usable retry path.
sourceFindings.actual: The table says No request details found, indistinguishable from a successful empty result, with no error or retry.

sourceFindings.expected: Reject or clearly explain that Start Date must not be after End Date.
sourceFindings.actual: The inverted range is accepted and the table displays No request details found without validation or error text.

sourceFindings.expected: The toggle is a keyboard-focusable switch/checkbox with a name and state.
sourceFindings.actual: It is a click-only DIV with tabIndex -1, no role, and no aria-checked. Pointer toggling works, but keyboard and assistive technology cannot operate or determine its state.

sourceFindings.control: Sortable usage table headers and expandable group rows
steps: Inspect sortable TH elements and grouped TR elements
Attempt to reach them with Tab
sourceFindings.expected: Sort and expand actions are keyboard-focusable and expose sort/expanded state.
sourceFindings.actual: Clickable TH and TR elements have tabIndex -1 and no button role; sortable headers expose only visual arrows and grouped rows expose no keyboard action.

sourceFindings.expected: Escape closes the drawer and the visual backdrop has an equivalent accessible dismissal action.
sourceFindings.actual: Escape leaves the drawer open; the full-screen backdrop is a click-only DIV with no role, name, or keyboard focus. The named Close menu button works.

sourceFindings.control: Key row icon actions and shared header/pagination icon actions
sourceFindings.preconditions: seeded endpoint page and usage pagination
steps: Inspect accessibility names for reveal, copy, delete, switches, language, menu, previous and next
sourceFindings.expected: Every icon-only action has a stable, purpose-specific accessible name including row context where needed.
sourceFindings.actual: Several controls expose only Material Symbols text such as visibility, content_copy, delete, grid_view, chevron_left/right, or no name at all; repeated key-row actions are indistinguishable by key.

sourceFindings.control: Overview/Details, periods, pagination and request collapsibles
sourceFindings.expected: Selected tab/period/page and expanded sections expose programmatic current/pressed/selected/expanded state.
sourceFindings.actual: Segmented buttons have no tab role or aria-pressed/selected, pagination has no aria-current, and collapsible section buttons have no aria-expanded/controls.
